declaration_verdict.note: SINGLE_SOURCE_DELTA; relation lean weaker; the auditor's reading: For n > 0 and admissible data at all orders < n, there is an Admissible record at order n satisfying StepProperties: the single-order construction step from the finalized lower orders.

theorem exists_step {S : Set ℝ} {h C : ℝ} (s : Scheme S h C) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (previous : (j : ℕ) → j < n → Admissible s j) :
    ∃ out : Admissible s n, StepProperties s n previous out
